criteria.name: Hook strength
criteria.notes: Opens with named deployment (Mastadon Fire, SE of Talkeetna, DFFP drone, 18.4 acres, 100% containment). Stands alone as a hook, clears the ~210-char see-more cutoff. Capital consequence implied rather than named in first two lines, so just below 10.

criteria.name: Industry relevance
criteria.notes: Every story carries an Alaska anchor plus a named industry consequence. DFFP deployment, $11M XPRIZE, UAF ACUASI, five named finalists, source-selection/past-performance, HB 217 as procurement risk.

criteria.name: Factual density
criteria.notes: Specifics nearly every sentence: dates, 18.4 acres, #131, DFFP UAS Module, $11M, 10-minute rule, five finalists with countries, HB 217 39-1 April 30, Senate Rules, May 20/21.

criteria.name: Source quality
criteria.notes: All three clusters trace to primary sources (akfireinfo/DFFP, xprize.org, akleg.gov + Alaska Public Media), HTTP 200 in verified_findings.

criteria.name: Voice match
criteria.notes: Analytical, position-taking, structural. 'The capability story buries the value-capture story' and 'neither the IP nor the rulebook' are on-brand. No influencer cadence.

criteria.name: Readability (LinkedIn)
criteria.notes: 2-3 sentence paragraphs, ~414 words, ~2673 chars under cap, easy mobile scan. Optional bullet block unused.

criteria.name: Engagement question
criteria.notes: Real, debatable question tied to the value-capture tension, names three stakeholder positions. No CTA or softener.

criteria.name: Business actionability
criteria.notes: Reader can track the five XPRIZE finalists for federal recompetes, flag HB 217 stall as procurement risk, note past-performance certification dynamic.

one_sentence_fix: Append a clause to the second hook sentence naming the capital consequence so the stake is explicit before the see-more cutoff.
